name: context-window
description: Display full code context in the panel, similar to the context window in Source Insight.

commands.title: Navigate to the uri and line
Toggle: Double-Click Selects Whole Bracket/Quote Pair (incl. delimiters)

contextView.contextWindow.updateMode.description: Controls how the context view is updated when the cursor moves.
enumDescriptions: The context view tracks the current cursor position. Display empty content if no symbol is found at the current position.
The context view tries to show the context for the symbol at the current cursor position. If there is none, it continues showing the last available context.

contextView.contextWindow.selectionBackg.description: Context Window 选中区域背景色

contextView.contextWindow.inactiveSelect.description: Context Window 非活动选中区域背景色

contextView.contextWindow.selectionHighl.description: Context Window 选中高亮背景色
Context Window 选中高亮边框色

contextView.contextWindow.minimap.description: Controls whether the Context Window minimap is shown.

contextView.contextWindow.useDefaultToke.description:
Using the default tokenizer of Monaco Editor.
Take effect when VSCode starts.

contextView.contextWindow.fixToken.description:
In VSCode, treat #include, #pragma, #region, and #endregion as distinct tokens, separate from #directive.
Take effect when VSCode starts.

contextView.contextWindow.cacheSizeLimit.description: Maximum number of files to cache in the frontend (webview). When exceeded, eviction uses a size-aware recency score so larger files (more expensive to reload) are kept longer, but no file lives forever.

contextView.contextWindow.backendLargeFi.description: Size threshold in KB for large files in the extension host. Files whose content is larger than this value are cached in the backend to avoid re-reading them.

contextView.contextWindow.backendCacheSi.description: Maximum number of large files cached in the extension host (backend). When exceeded, the least recently used file is evicted.

contextView.contextWindow.lightThemeRule.description: Light theme token color rules saved from right-click token style picker.

contextView.contextWindow.darkThemeRules.description: Dark theme token color rules saved from right-click token style picker.

contextView.contextWindow.fixStickyScrol.description:
Extend sticky scroll parsing for C, C++, and C#.
Take effect when VSCode starts.

contextView.contextWindow.doubleClickSel.description: Double-clicking right next to a bracket ( [ { < or a quote " ' ` selects the whole matching pair INCLUDING the brackets/quotes themselves. Complements VSCode's built-in editor.doubleClickSelectsBlock, which selects only the content inside. Toggle it from the status bar ({si}), the editor right-click menu, or the keyboard shortcut.

contextView.contextWindow.enableHover.description: Show hover tooltips (parameter signatures, JSDoc, etc.) in the Context Window. Hover requests are forwarded to the active language servers of the main editor.

contextView.contextWindow.occurrencesHig.description: Highlight every occurrence of the word under the cursor, like editor.occurrencesHighlight in the main editor. Off by default: the cursor in the Context Window is placed programmatically when jumping or navigating back, so this highlight easily lands on a neighbouring identifier instead of the token you clicked. The token you jumped out from is always highlighted on its own, regardless of this setting.

contextView.contextWindow.jumpTrail.description: Show the jump trail (definition hop breadcrumbs) at the top of the Context Window. On by default. Can be toggled from the right-click menu.

contextView.contextWindow.stickyScroll.description: Show sticky scroll (pinned function/class headers) in the Context Window. When null (default), it follows the main editor's editor.stickyScroll.enabled setting. Toggling it from the right-click menu writes this setting explicitly, which then takes precedence over the main editor's value.
